title: PhoStream: Benchmarking Real-World Streaming for Omnimodal Assistants in Mobile Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the rate at which models respond prematurely to 'Forward' questions before the necessary visual or audio evidence appears in the streaming video. This is evaluated using an Online Inference Pipeline with strict timestamp cutoffs (Timestamp Proactive), where any response prior to the evidence appearing is penalized and categorized as an Early Response (ER).
